title: Bregman geometry in regular exponential families: dual representations and relative smoothness
abstract: arXiv:2611.18480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Regular exponential-family distributions are ubiquitous in statistics due to their appealing and convenient properties. Notably, they can be expressed in terms of Bregman divergences, revealing fundamental connections between statistics, convex analysis, and information geometry. However, this geometric structure has not been systematically exploited to characterize these distributions with respect to their expectation parametrization. Building on a projective characterization, we establish a general construction of equivalent dual Bregman representations, together with normalization and uniqueness results. These representations express log-densities as ordinary Bregman divergences in dual coordinate systems, providing geometric characterizations of the parameter space. translated_title: 正则指数族中的Bregman几何：对偶表示与相对光滑性
translated_abstract: 正则指数族分布在统计学中无处不在，因为其具有优美且便利的性质。值得注意的是，这类分布可以用Bregman散度来表示，从而揭示了统计学、凸分析和信息几何之间的基本联系。然而，这一几何结构尚未被系统地用于刻画这些分布相对于其期望参数化的性质。基于射影刻画，我们建立了等价对偶Bregman表示的一般性构造，并给出了归一化与唯一性结果。这些表示将对数密度表达为对偶坐标系中的普通Bregman散度，从而为参数空间提供了几何刻画。所谓的β-与α-缩放对偶表示作为该框架的特殊实例自然涌现。我们进一步推导了共轭……（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文基于射影刻画，为正则指数族在期望参数化下建立了一般性的等价对偶Bregman表示构造（含归一化与唯一性结果），使对数密度可表达为对偶坐标系中的普通Bregman散度，并将β-与α-缩放对偶表示作为该框架的特例。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes, via a projective characterization, a general construction of equivalent dual Bregman representations for expectation-parametrized regular exponential families—with normalization and uniqueness results—and recovers β- and α-scaled dual representations as special cases of this framework.
